description: Agent Water Records: submit a water utility’s meter records with the readings and reading history they answer to: the reading moment; each meter the meter record lists with its id, reference, the service connection and the moments installed and removed; each meter reading with its id, reference, the meter, the register, whether it is estimated and the moment read; each usage entry with its id, reference, the meter, the reading days its period starts and ends and the volume it records; each meter test entry with its id, reference, the meter, the moment tested and the moment the next test is due. The signed report gives the readings and the records behind them, each reading against a listed meter and its installed period, each register reading against the meter’s previous reading, each usage entry against the register difference between the readings at its period ends, and each meter test due against a later test of the meter, and counts them, and names divergent water meter records: a reading on a meter the meter record does not list or outside its installed period, a register reading below the meter’s previous reading, a usage entry the readings at its period ends do not support, and a meter test due with none recorded; then two readings for one meter on one day that differ and a meter read by estimate on consecutive readings, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No meter readings, or no meter list beside readings, leaves those points unverified. Meters and readings match by letters and digits, registers and volumes to the hundredth in the unit the record uses, readings run in date order, dates read by the day, and a test due after the reading moment waits. This reads the utility’s own meter readings against its reading history, with no tariff read: wever_energy-bill-check reads a utility bill against its tariff, while the meter record check reads whether every reading, register and usage entry in the meter record holds together. Verdict water_meter_record_divergent, water_meter_record_partial, water_meter_record_unverified or water_meter_record_consistent. POST /api/water-meter-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

meters.description: Each meter the meter record lists.

estimated.description: Whether the record marks the reading as estimated.

register.description: Amount the register shows, in the unit the record uses.

next_due_at.description: When the next test is due, such as 2026-03-02.

usage.description: Each usage entry the meter record derives from its readings.

from.description: The reading day the period starts, such as 2026-03-02.

to.description: The reading day the period ends, such as 2026-03-02.

volume.description: Amount of usage the entry records, in the unit the record uses.
